gizmo.title: Sheet music
gizmo.description: Renders and plays sheet music, guitar tabs, and score notation via alphaTex or MusicXML.

configure.title: AlphaTex notation
configure.description: Inline alphaTex markup for the sheet music. Edit directly to author notation; it is stored in a template so spacing is preserved.

configure.title: Score file
configure.description: Upload or link to a MusicXML (.xml/.musicxml/.mxl) or Guitar Pro (.gp3/.gp4/.gp5/.gpx/.gp) file. Overrides inline alphaTex when set.

advanced.title: Audio playback
advanced.description: On by default - listen to the sheet music played via the built-in synthesizer. Turn off for viewer-only (no audio) mode.

advanced.title: Show display options
advanced.description: Show zoom, stretch, and layout buttons on the player bar.

advanced.title: Show export buttons
advanced.description: Show download MIDI and print/PDF buttons on the player bar.

documentation.purpose: Lets educators author and embed playable sheet music and guitar tabs in HAX pages, supporting open MusicXML for sharing and alphaTex for inline authoring.
